title: Traffic Accident Risk Prediction
author: Khalid Ameen, Subathira Thinakaran, Burhanuddin Ujjainwala
description: This use case analyses traffic accident severity by combining crash records with weather, mobility, temporal, and road-related features. The project explores accident patterns, validates an integrated dataset, compares baseline and advanced machine learning models, and identifies key risk factors such as speed zone, time-based patterns, weather conditions, and mobility density. The final insights support road safety planning and dashboard-based decision-making.
